title: ME60114: Surface Engineered Materials Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Influence of manufacturing processes on various surface properties of an
engineering component; scope of surface engineering in augmentation of surface
properties
Different processes used in surface engineering – surface coatings and surface
modifications, application oriented surface engineering processes – for 3D
surface, powder like substrate, internal surface, mass production; surface
engineering problems related to substrate characteristics.
Evaluation of engineered properties – control properties, response properties;
surface geometry – characterization techniques (conventional and recent
trends); coating thickness measurements – laboratory techniques and special
techniques for accurate routine thickness measurements; adhesion measurement –
conventional methods and recent developments; Measurement of mechanical
properties of engineered surface in nano scale; Evaluation of tribological
characteristics of engineered surface in macro, micro and nano scale,
simulation of actual application environment in tribometer.
